name: Zinc
description: Lets AI agents search and buy from Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and more via API or hosted MCP, paying per order with x402, MPP or a card. Backed by Y Combinator.

skills.name: Search Product Catalogs
skills.description: Searches products across major retailers and returns up to 20 orderable results with price, retailer and rating.

skills.name: Check Out on Major Retailers
skills.description: Places orders at retailers like Amazon, Walmart and Target with a max price and shipping address through the orders API.

skills.name: Pay with x402 or MPP
skills.description: Places agent orders with no account or API key, paying per order over HTTP 402 with x402, MPP on Tempo, or Link.

skills.name: Track Orders and Returns
skills.description: Follows order status and shipment tracking, receives webhook updates and starts returns for supported retailers.
